name: xfix
description: Check whether AI assistants and shopping agents can read a website or online store.

interface.longDescription:
xfix checks how AI assistants and AI shopping agents see a public web page or online store, using the same checks as xfix.ai.

Ask things like "Can AI shop this store?", "Which AI crawlers can read example.com?" or "Check this product page for AI shoppers" and xfix will read the site's robots.txt the way 9 search and AI crawlers do, fetch a page without running JavaScript and say whether its main text is there, check a product page for price, stock and six product structured data fields, run the xfix search check on one page (a score out of 100, a grade and the 5 biggest point losses with fixes), and look up a store's AI Shopping Readiness Index score.

For store owners, marketers and developers. Every answer links to the full result on xfix.ai. No sign-in needed.

Limits: one public page per check; xfix cannot see pages behind a login, does not test checkout, and cannot see CDN or firewall rules. It does not check websites that sell age-restricted goods.

xfix stores the checked URL, the tool, the time and the check result for 90 days, so answers can link to the full result; if you save that result to an xfix account, it stays with your account. It receives nothing from your conversation.
capabilities: Look up AI Shopping Readiness Index score
defaultPrompt: Can AI shop my store? mystore.com
Which AI crawlers can read my website?
Check this product page for AI shoppers

positive.description: Store readiness without a product link
positive.prompt: Can AI shop this store? allbirds.com
positive.expected_behavior: Reports which of 9 crawlers robots.txt allows, says the store is not in the AI Shopping Readiness Index, and asks for one product page link. Ends with a link to xfix.ai.

positive.prompt: Check this product page for AI shoppers: https://wpfactory.com/item/product-quantity-for-woocommerce/
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether price and stock are in the HTML, lists which of the six product structured data fields are present and names the missing ones, and links to the stored product-schema report.

positive.prompt: Which AI crawlers can read xfix.ai?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 9 crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User), all allowed, and notes CDN or firewall rules are not checked.

positive.prompt: Can ChatGPT read https://xfix.ai/ without JavaScript?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the main text is present in the HTML with its word count, and links to the tool page on xfix.ai.

positive.prompt: Run an xfix search check on https://xfix.ai/
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a score out of 100, a grade, coverage and the 5 biggest point losses with fixes; if the first call returns a check_id, the result arrives on the follow-up call.

negative.description: Purchasing is not supported: xfix has no purchase or checkout tool and must not be called. ChatGPT may handle the request by other means.
negative.prompt: Buy the Wool Runners from allbirds.com for me

negative.description: Age-restricted store: xfix runs no check and replies that it doesn't check websites that sell age-restricted goods.
negative.prompt: Can AI shop this wine store? craftwinestore.com.au

negative.description: No account access or edits: xfix has no sign-in or write tool and must not be called. ChatGPT may handle the request by other means.
negative.prompt: Log in to my Shopify admin and fix my product schema

review.commerce_description: xfix does not sell products or process payments. It only checks public web pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 7 read-only tools for AI crawler access, page text without JavaScript, product page data, xfix search visibility score and AI Shopping Readiness Index lookup.
